events.body:
## Context

`src/local_settings.py` lists plugins that don't exist; the root `terms.html` and `welcome_message.txt` aren't used (the worker serves `src/lettuce/templates/terms.html` and reads `src/workspace_welcome_message_<team>.txt`); `tests/plugins/test_handle_messages.py` is fully commented out; `.env.sample` has a stray practice comment.

## What to do

1. Grep each file before deleting it, then delete or fix.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] `npx wrangler dev` serves /, /terms and /health

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-lettuce
```

---
